title: Uz
summary: Fertile land. (1.) The son of Aram, and grandson of Shem (Gen. 10:23; 1 Chr. 1:17).

inlines.v: Fertile land. (1.) The son of Aram, and grandson of Shem (Gen. 10:23; 1 Chr. 1:17).
(2.) One of the Horite "dukes" in the land of Edom (Gen. 36:28).
(3.) The eldest son of Nahor, Abraham's brother (Gen. 22:21, R.V.).
